tags.feature: - The game will feature 3 game modes:
- Hunt Mode: The classic battle where 1 player is the Hunter and the others are the Prey. Best enjoyed with a full lobby!
- Deathmatch Mode: You and your friends fight until one survives.
- Escape Mode: Play solo or in a group as you try to escape from monsters, labyrinths, and solve puzzles to survive.
- apart from Hunt Mode, the game will support both first-person and third-person perspectives, giving players more ways to experience the hunt.
- Private matches with friends or global public lobbies with up to 5 players.
- Switch between first-person or third-person gameplay (except in Hunt Mode).
- Create public or private lobbies to challenge players worldwide.
- Communicate with others through voice and text chat.
- Explore richly detailed environments while trying to survive.
- Have fun and interact in tense, strategy-filled matches.

notes.title: New game from FakeFox is in development!
notes.content:
Dear survivors, we are pleased to announce the development of Dolls: The Hunt. Set in the same universe as Dolls, this new game will be multiplayer, allowing you to play with your friends in exciting matches.

[h3]Summary[/h3]
When transported to a dark dimension inhabited by strange dolls, you find yourself in the body of one of them, where your only priority is to survive and escape this new nightmare. However, you now face an unusual enemy: a war veteran who still sees himself on the battlefield and is determined to eliminate all his 'enemies' in this unknown world!

[h3]Play with your friends![/h3]
Play with your friends in private matches or in public global lobbies, with up to 5 people, where one participant in the group will be chosen as the hunter and the others as prey!

[h3]Game Features[/h3]
[list][*]Play in first person as the hunter or in third person as the survivor.[/list]
[list][*]Create public or private lobbies to play with other players.[/list]
[list][*]Chat with other players through voice or text chat.[/list]
[list][*]Enjoy a richly detailed environment while you try to survive.[/list]
[list][*]Have fun and interact with your friends![/list]

[h3]Support the Dolls series![/h3]
To support the project, add it to your wishlist! The release is scheduled for early 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065180/Dolls_The_Hunt/

Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!
